To enroll this TV in the Apple Beta Software Program, you must agree to all the following terms

This AirPlay Third-Party Device Profile (the “Profile”) generates files that allow Apple to connect and exchange information between your Apple-issued development-fused device with your own non-Apple third party device (“Personal Device”), such as your third-party television, set-top box or other AirPlay-capable device, to help Apple to improve its products and services. The generated log files may include information about metadata of an AirPlay or other app session, such as the use of certain applications, length of sessions, capture date and time, file size, and Personal Device information and location. Apple will not collect information about the content you view in an AirPlay session.
 
The Personal Device must be both (a) owned by you and (b) located in your residence or office or carried with you. Do not enroll the Profile on any device that is not your own co-located Personal Device.

This Profile will automatically expire after 30 days, except that every time you use AirPlay with your Apple-issued development-fused device on your Personal Device (“Interaction”), such Interaction will automatically extend the term of enrollment by successive rolling 30 day periods whenever there is an Interaction within a 30 day period. You can stop the Profile from generating logs by going to AirPlay > Software Updates > Beta Updates. By following our instructions for enabling the Profile and sending copies of the logs and/or other information to Apple, you consent to Apple's use of the content of such files in accordance with Apple's privacy policy, which is available at https://people.apple.com/US/en/resource/2435/display?wc=nav.
 
By downloading or using the Profile, you hereby release Apple from all liability, claims and damages arising from or relating to the Profile and/or software update for any and all damage, harm, corruption, data loss or interference to or with your Personal Device.
